methods: All behavior verified through Codely Unity Bridge in actual Play. Collider fixtures use real Physics2D.Simulate through the original unique World.FixedUpdate. Fixture preparation may position bodies, set initial velocity, disable motors or reduce initial health to exercise death edges; no contacts/propagation are injected.

Normal fixed-layout battle trials retain all saved physical/motor/magnetic settings and health defaults, with zero player movement input and one marking at logical step 70 or 150. Both scenarios have exact fresh-Play repetitions and real engine FixedUpdate replays.

R tests call the same SampleRestartInput(true) path used by Update/GetKeyDown(R), and actually LoadSceneAsync(Game,Single). Scene-loaded observation pauses the new World before its first simulation to check exact initial state.

Trigger Enter/Stay numbers are merged with current overlap queries for already touched spikes, including sleeping rigidbodies. Spikes were temporary Play fixtures; the saved Game corridor was not expanded with hazard content.
Final Game screenshot shows the read-only debug panel, not proof of dynamics.

corrections.issue: Sleeping player stopped receiving Trigger Stay callbacks
corrections.fix: World queries current overlaps for known spikes after its one physics step; final spikes and exit tests passed.

corrections.issue: Temporary verification script JSON serialization of Vector2 and MarkResult field projection
corrections.fix: Flattened vectors and used Request.TargetId, then reran affected scenarios in fresh Play; not project compile failures.

limitations: No physical keyboard injection, standalone build, cross-device determinism, blind playtest or complex concave navigation tested.
Saved Game has no spike layout yet. Spike adapter and genuine trigger behavior verified using temporary fixtures; room design belongs to step 11.

Fixed-layout stationary-player battle comparisons demonstrate two kills and longer survival, but both end Lost. A stable budget-limited solution for all six enemies remains level-design validation; victory flow is verified with genuine physical hazard fixtures, including six enemies removed in one step.
Damage and life indicators use the existing temporary debug panel; formal HUD, hit flashes, audio and pause/slow controls remain later steps.
No turret/projectile implementation yet, so no remaining projectile danger can be tested; terminal phase prevents all subsequent World physics.
